tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dark_willow_shadow_: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has %attack_range_bonus% bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after %max_damage_duration% seconds.

While in Shadow Realm, Dark Willow emits a %aura_radius% radius aura that increases damage that she deals to enemies in its area of effect by up to %aura_damage_pct%%%. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm.
What you can't see will most definitely hurt you.
Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.
Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_dark_willow_bio:
Children love telling stories about the whimsical adventures of fairies... That’s because children don’t know that most fairies are spiteful jerks. And in the world of spiteful fairies there are few names spoken of with more contempt than Mireska Sunbreeze.

Born to a fae merchant king, Mireska grew up in Revtel; a cutthroat nation where manipulation and murder were the norm. But while she was quite adept at navigating the etiquette, unspoken laws, and social rituals that permeated every element of her life, she found the whole thing rather boring.

So, Mireska did what most rebellious children do: burn down her family estate and set off with her pet wisp Jex to live the life of a wandering grifter.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_dark_willow_hype: A slight flutter from the shadows may be all an enemy sees of Dark Willow, as she eludes pursuit and controls her foe's movements with cunning fae tricks. Calling upon powers far more ancient than any scholarly magic, she binds enemies in place before unleashing the full wrath and terror of the fae realm upon them.

qualifications.raw:
* Applies {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|dark_willow_shadow_realm_fade_time}} on self upon cast, with the following properties:
** Does not interrupt Mireska's {{M|channeling}} abilities.
** {{Symbol|Attack Damage}}
*** Mireska is issued a stop order upon casting the ability while attacking.
*** However, when given an attack order while beyond her {{M|attack range}}, casting Shadow Realm while she moves does not stop her from attacking immediately.
** Reapplying the buff at this point refreshes the effect delay duration.

* {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|dark_willow_shadow_realm_buff}} has four main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]] {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** The ability effects are applied on self as follows after the {{#var:Shadow Realm value1}}-second effect delay, with the following bonuses:
**** {{M|Attack immune}}.
**** {{M|Disjoint}} incoming {{M|projectiles}}.
**** Flat {{M|ranged}} bonus {{M|attack range}}.
**** {{M|Phase movement}}.
**** {{M|Untargetable}} to all units, except Mireska {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeting herself.
**** Casting other abilities do not end Shadow Realm.
**** Reapplying the buff now refreshes its duration.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] {{Symbol|bonus ampin-n}} {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
*** Incoming offensive attacks and unit-targeted abilities on Mireska which are already in its [[attack animation|attack]] or [[cast animation]] is canceled.
*** Does not prevent {{M|Spell Reflection}} source procs.
*** Certain abilities do [[Non-targetable#Bypassing Unselectability|bypass unselectability]] conditionally. However, generally all other abilities treats Mireska as if she were {{M|invisible}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|21px|3]] {{Symbol|a|Up}}
*** The following values change per {{M|channeling}} {{M|server tick}} while {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|dark_willow_shadow_realm_buff}} is active, over {{#expr:trunc({{#var:Shadow Realm value5}}/{{G|tick rate}})}} instances:
**** Increases the total {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} by {{calc|v1/({{#var:Shadow Realm value5}}/{{G|tick rate}}) round2|v1={{#var:Shadow Realm value4}}}} per interval.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Has the following targeting functionalities:
** {{Symbol|Target|Area-Dummy}} {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Dark Willow Bramble Maze Formation Visualized icon.png|105px|Bramble Maze Formation Visualized.]]
*** Has a custom area-targeting indicator with all brambles' formation visualized as above.
*** [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-1.png|84px]]
**** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{calc|v1+{{#var:Bramble Maze value1}}+{{#var:Bramble Maze type1 value1}}|v1={{#var:Bramble Maze cast range}}}}-distance away with the [[cast range]], bramble spawn radius, and the {{M|root}} search radius. 
** {{Symbol|Target|Portrait}}
*** Considers [[portrait-casting]] as a {{Symbol|Target|Ground}} ground-targeted cast, and centers the radius around Mireska.

* The ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]]
*** The created brambles are always in the same formation.
*** {{#var:Bramble Maze value3}} seconds after casting, each bramble spaws from the inner to the outer circle in {{#var:Bramble Maze value4}}-second intervals according to the following anticlockwise sequence:
**** [[File:Dota2 Dark Willow Bramble Maze Formation (Inner) icon.png|84px|Inner Circle]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Dark Willow Bramble Maze Formation (Outer) icon.png|84px|Outer Circle]]
**** [[File:Dota2 Anticlockwise.png|31px|Anticlockwise]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Letter-r.png|21px|R]] {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Letter-s.png|21px|S]]
*** All brambles take {{#vardefineecho:Bramble Maze formation time|{{#expr:(({{#var:Bramble Maze value5}}-1)*{{#var:Bramble Maze value4}}+{{#var:Bramble Maze value3}})}}}} seconds to take formation.
*** Each bramble has its own independent duration and {{M|root}} activation duration, staring upon its creation.
**** Hence, the last bramble disappears {{#expr:{{#var:Bramble Maze formation time}}+{{#var:Bramble Maze value7}}}} seconds after cast.
*** {{Symbol|fx|v}} {{Symbol|fx|s}}
**** All ability visual and sound effects during the spawn delay are only visible and audible ally-only.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** The ability effects are applied as follows within the root search radius on the first enemy unit, after its activation delay based on its source:
***# {{Symbol|Root}}
***#* The corresponding bramble disappears once it applies the [[root]] debuff.
***#* Grants {{M|True Sight}} over the affected enemy unit.
***#* Affects the following units:
***#** {{M|Fogged units}}.
***#** {{M|Invisible}} units.
***#* Reapplying the debuff applies another indepenet instance.
***#* Leveling up the ability does not update the current bramble's root duration.
***# Deals {{#var:Bramble Maze type1 value3}} {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} in {{#var:Bramble Maze type1 value2}}-second intervals, starting {{#var:Bramble Maze type1 value2}} seconds upon debuff application, over {{calc|v1/{{#var:Bramble Maze type1 value2}}|v1={{#var:Bramble Maze type1 value4}}}} instances.

*** Mireska is issued a stop order upon casting the ability while attacking.

** Reapplying the buff at this point refreshes the effect delay duration.
